messages:
mike: proposing a 6-week "Closure Sprint" pilot to cut down stale postmortem actions. core pieces: one tiny tracker, weekly 15m sync, rotating closure_owner, simple SLA bands, and recurrence surfacing. low friction.

sara: +1. tiny tracker cols?

mike: minimal: incident_id, one-line summary, remediation_owner, closure_owner, next_action, due_date(YYYY-MM-DD), status, verification_plan, recurrence_count, rca_link. keep it to one row per action.

leo: let's have closure_owner != remediation_owner. closure_owner drives to verified-done. rotate weekly with oncall.

anita: can we add a "regression_check" milestone (7d + 30d) in verification_plan so we don't ship-and-forget?

mike: yes, include that. ops-bot will nudge 48h before due_date and again at due_date.

ops-bot: Reminder: INC-2331 has 2 overdue follow-ups. Please assign closure_owner.

sara: i'll migrate the backlog RCAs into the tracker and assign closure owners for anything >30d old. target migration by 2123456805.

leo: i'll prototype a recurrence detector (fingerprint by error text + stack) and emit a weekly top-10 CSV with recurrence_count + last_seen. prototype by 2123456900.

anita: propose SLA bands: P0 7d, P1 21d, P2 60d. escalate P0s into the weekly sync until closed.

mike: weekly sync: Thursdays 09:00 PT, 15m. attendees: oncall, last RCA owner, infra rep, docs. agenda: quick status roll (30s per item), unblock asks, one recurrence highlight.

sara: volunteered to be first closure_owner rotation lead and will run the first three syncs.

mike: immediate actions:
- backlog migration (sara) - due 2123456805
- recurrence prototype (leo) - due 2123456900
- handbook page + tracker template (mike) - due 2123456820
- ops-bot reminders config (anita) - due 2123456840

mike: we'll measure closure rate, median time-to-close, and recurrence density over 6 weeks. if useful, fold into oncall SOP. will post the hub link once the handbook page is live. :rocket:
